items.text: If you have already read a general paramedical courses guide, you have seen medical laboratory technology mentioned as one line among ten specializations.
Most articles on this topic list "hospital or diagnostic lab" as the whole answer.
Own or franchise an NABL-accredited diagnostic lab
The only track here with real pricing control, hiring advantage, and repeat-revenue upside.

blocks.heading: Waste a Year and a Lakh

items.text: They overlap but are not the same credential.

A diploma or degree that is not aligned with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions' notified curriculum may not lead to a real registration number later, which means you cannot legally practise.
Confirm your shortlisted DMLT or BMLT course is NCAHP-aligned and check the current-year NEET requirement on the official portal before paying any fee.
Decide early whether the government-exam entry requirement matters to you, and if it does, start tracking recruitment notifications from your final year onward rather than after graduation.

Plan from year one to add NABL/ISO 15189 quality-system knowledge on top of your technical training, it is the specific skill that separates a capped salary from a real path toward lab management or eventually running your own accredited lab.

DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology)
Fastest, cheapest route to entry-level lab work; caps your ceiling faster than a degree unless you upgrade later
BMLT or B.MLS (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology or Science)
Opens supervisory roles faster, is the minimum most corporate hospital chains prefer, and is required for most postgraduate options
M.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology / Clinical Microbiology
Needed for teaching roles, senior research-lab positions, and some quality-manager postings at larger chains

blocks.heading: Owns a Full Lab Section, Trains Junior

figures.label: Relevant Experience Window
figures.source: Owns a full lab section, trains junior technologists, and signs off on quality-control checks before results reach a doctor. This rung typically needs 3-6 years of hands-on experience.
figures.text: This rung typically needs 3-6 years of hands-on experience.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: A salaried lab-tech career in this field caps out somewhere around Rs 11-18 LPA even at a senior quality-manager level in a large chain, and that ceiling is fixed by someone else's pay band. Running or franchising your own NABL-accredited diagnostic lab is the one real path here with no fixed ceiling, pricing, hiring, and repeat-patient revenue are yours to control.
